content.text:
`AcceptanceTest` is the only test class, and the full `mvn test` build passes green.

## Summary

The create audit line now also logs `membershipLevel` (already present) and the newly added `membershipNumber`, while keeping every previously logged field.

To avoid duplicating the membership-number formatting rule, I extracted it into a new util class that matches the existing pattern of `MembershipLevel`/`MembershipPoints`:

- **`util/MembershipNumber.java`** (new) — single-responsibility helper holding the `<customerCode>-M<YY>` formatting (with the same null-guards the mapper had).
- **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — `membershipNumber(owner)` now delegates to `MembershipNumber.of(owner)` instead of inlining the format, so the response DTO and the audit line share one source of truth.
- **`rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — the `AUDIT.info(...)` call gained a `membershipNumber={}` field populated via `MembershipNumber.of(owner)`.

The acceptance test — which asserts the audit line contains both the response's `membershipNumber` and `membershipLevel` — passes, and `mvn test` is green.
